notes.title: BackStreet Update Notes (July 17, 2025)
notes.content:
📌 BackStreet Update Note (July 17, 2025)
This update focuses on improving combat presentation, input responsiveness, tutorial flow, and sub-weapon usability. Character animations and visual feedback are more natural, and tutorials have been refined for clarity.


🎮 Combat & Control Improvements
- Final aerial combo now strikes the enemy 3 times

- Trail effects added to aerial combos for stronger impact

- Jump-to-attack cancel condition adjusted for smoother chaining

- Dodge input condition refined for better responsiveness

- Added toggle-off input for "Hold to Sprint" option

- Fixed arm animation issue when using sub-weapons in the air

- Improved upper-body blending between jump and sub-weapon animations

- Fixed character rotation issue when using a skill during cooldown

- Added a 0.05s delay when using sub-weapons


🛠 Bug Fixes
- Fixed rare crash at game start

- Fixed unnatural player shaking during aerial combos


🎓 Tutorial Improvements
- Fixed issue where tutorial could not proceed at certain points

- Adjusted map layout: sub-weapon box repositioned, trigger volume resized

- Removed temporary debug item from tutorial


🧩 UI & Localization
- Refined spacing and wording for "About Full Release" section

- Added missing localized strings

- Improved phrasing for booster chip discard confirmation

notes.title: BackStreet Update Notes (July 15, 2025)
notes.content:
⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (July 15, 2025)
This demo update brings improvements to combat visuals, stage flow, control usability, and adds a new menu introducing information about the full version.


🎮 Combat & Targeting Improvements  
- Action Launch condition relaxed: Previously triggered only when enemies were over 200 units away, now activates at 50 units or more  

- Targeting range for bosses increased: Lock-on is now maintained at nearly double the previous range


🛠 Bug Fixes  
- Fixed an issue where training dummies floated or failed to disappear


📘 Combat & Chapter Structure Adjustments  
- One additional early-stage combat section has been added to improve pacing  

- The cost of the following skills has increased by 5: Multi Slash, Linear Slash, Weak Point Analysis, and Hell Purge


⚖ Balance Adjustments  
- Healing item prices reduced by 10 to ease resource management


🖥 UI & UX Improvements  
- Changed prompt when declining rewards: “Continue” → “Discard”  

- The lock-on button for gamepads has been unified with the camera reset function and changed to the right analog stick (R3).


📌 New Menu: About the Full Version  
- A new “About the Full Version” menu has been added to the main screen  

- Includes upcoming features and systems with images and localization support

notes.title: BackStreet Update Notes (v0.2.0, July 14, 2025)
notes.content:
⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (v0.2.0, July 14, 2025)
This update focuses on improving combat feedback, refining the targeting system, and enhancing tutorials and guidance. Control responsiveness and visual feedback have been significantly improved, along with a more polished UI and combat presentation.


🎮 Combat System & Feedback Improvements
- Hard targeting reintroduced: target lock-on and dedicated camera angle applied

- Soft targeting reworked: directional input-based targeting and priority logic improved

- Camera reset function added (excluding Pitch)

- Knockback logic improvements:

　　- Combo knockback reduced (5x → 3.5x)

　　- Max distance limited to 200

　　- Knockback resistance added based on defense stat

- Hitstop enhanced and now differentiates normal vs. critical attacks

- Action launch direction corrected and range limit removed

- Mid-air jittering during attacks resolved, collision handling optimized

- Default key input changes:

　　- Keyboard: Dodge (LShift → LAlt)

　　- Controller: Fire (LT → merged with attack key)




📘 Tutorial & Guidance Enhancements
- Added tutorial dummies and new key-specific missions

- Key guide integrated into tutorial UI

- Gamepad and key binding options reflected in guides




🖥 UI & UX Improvements
- Improved visibility of information panels (blurred dark background applied)

- Removed keyguide display from material crafting UI

- Skill cooldown now highlighted

- Fixed focus issues in PauseMenu / WeaponSelect

- Localized naming of skills and items improved

- Tutorials restructured to be image-driven

- Overall map brightness adjusted

　　- Default gamma changed to 3.0




🛠 System Improvements & Fixes
- Stage length reduced:

　　- 5 combat stages, 2 crafting stages

- Added portal / gate indicators

- Added directional skill indicators for enemies

- Improved sub-weapon swapping: swap with current one instead of replacing

- Removed pillar interaction in boss maps

notes.title: BackStreet Demo Update Notes (April 24, 2025)
notes.content:
⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (April 24, 2025)

This update focuses on enhancing the intuitiveness and action-oriented nature of combat and interaction systems, as well as rebalancing early-stage difficulty and improving the item economy. Various improvements have been made to enhance overall stability and immersion.

---

🎮 Gameplay Balancing and Chapter Structure Adjustments
- Boss HP and defense increased: HP 1000 → 1250 / Defense 0.5 → 0.6
- Early chapters (first 3 stages) have reduced difficulty.
- Increased frequency of crafting stages. Early elite monster spawns have been removed to smooth out the difficulty curve.
- Item and healing system adjustments
  - Healing pack values adjusted: 30 / 50 / 90 → 15 / 30 / 50
  - Skill prices significantly lowered (e.g., Multi Slash: 15 → 8, Straight Slash: 15 → 5)
  - Healing vending machines improved: Prevents reuse after crafting, adds visual/audio effects, and now only outputs small heal items.

---

🎨 UI & UX Improvements
- Crafting material display added to Main HUD
- Fixed UI and currency icon errors at crafting stations
- Next-stage indication improved with +1 buffer to avoid confusion
- Camera control improvements
  - Smoother camera movement and character visibility handling
  - Improved camera response during skill usage; zoom/sensitivity fixes to come
- Combat and interaction system improvements
  - Trash bags can now be opened by attacking them

notes.title: BackStreet Demo Update Notes (March 17, 2025)
notes.content:
⚡ BackStreet Update Notes (March 17, 2025)

🎮 Combat System Improvements
- Slow Debuff Rework
  - Adjusted the Slow Debuff effect for better clarity.
  - Separated skill preparation & activation animations for BotTypeB / Elite / Boss enemies to improve timing.
  - Debuff Resist values now correctly apply to characters.
  - Slightly nerfed the Slow Debuff effect.

- Enemy Skill Improvements
  - Dash Attack and Jump Attack animations now connect more smoothly.
  - Energy Beam Attack now has a separate warning animation, giving players more time to react.
  - Fixed an issue where characters would spin incorrectly in certain skills.

- Booster Chip Balance Adjustments
  - Flame Booster Chip: Damage significantly increased (50x).
  - Oxidation Booster Chip: Damage increased (~10x).
  - Slow Debuff: Slight nerf (combo total debuff stat limited to 0.9).
  - Removed the player's default debuff stat.

---

🎨 UI/UX Improvements
- Remaining Stages Display Added
  - Players can now easily check the number of remaining stages.
  - New animations added for stage completion and new stage start.

- Credits Screen Added
  - Credits button added to the main menu.
  - View developer information in the Credits Screen.
  - Added animations and camera transitions.

---

🔧 Bug Fixes
- Fixed an issue where the Freeze Debuff was not applied.
- Fixed Slow Debuff issues.
  - Resolved cases where the effect did not apply correctly.
  - Fixed duplicate calculations of Debuff Resist values.
- Fixed Elite Monster scaling issue (Z scale adjusted 1.2 → 1.0).
- Fixed an issue where ESC/TAB menu could not be accessed after discarding Booster Chips.
- Improved Remaining Stages UI (added animations and better visibility).

---

This update includes combat system improvements, UI additions, balance adjustments, and various bug fixes.  
We will continue to enhance the game for a better experience! 🎮✨  

Thank you! 🚀
